description: The bar chart illustrates the comparative performance of three models, RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), across five different categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, and KoBEST-SN, as well as their average performance (AVG). The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the performance values, ranging from approximately 0 to 1.00, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1 or 0.2, although the exact tick label interval is not visible. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored dark blue for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and grey for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), with the grey bar consistently reaching the maximum value of 1.00 across all categories. The dark blue bars range from approximately 0.42 to 0.70, with the lowest value in PT-EVAL and the highest in KoBEST-CP, while the light blue bars range from about 0.46 to 0.74, with the lowest value in PT-EVAL and the highest in KoBEST-CP. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order observed within the groups, and the AVG category represents the average performance across the other categories. The chart does not display any visual emphasis on specific bars beyond the color coding indicated in the legend.
